why: design/forin-order.md: a for-in over a record the function makes reads its keys in property order (array indexes ascending, then creation order). Two literals in different orders differ (key_order, written, in_header, with_keys; via_dict through the dictionary carrier); the same order under another local name proves (same_order), and with Object.keys of the same local beside it (both_same); indexes come first whatever their place in the literal (index_first). A record from the outside is refused by key-order (escape forin_order_outside_record).
